title: Unit – 2 : Session – 3 : SLO – 2 | Loops
sections: Completed code: int i = 1;  while (i <= 5) { System.out.println("Java Rocks " + i);  i++;  // step counter  }
Output: Java Rocks 1 / Java Rocks 2 / Java Rocks 3 / Java Rocks 4 / Java Rocks 5

Explanation: the while loop checks i <= 5 before each iteration; the body prints the message with the current i, then i++ increments the counter; when i becomes 6 the condition fails and the loop ends — exactly 5 iterations.
